answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes: full rewards require deals with 12 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs; linked accounts count once. An orchard needs many pollinators; so does trust, not one handler. Each deal earns a jade mark; a prism view exposes star clusters. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 deals: 120,000 coins at 10 each, above the diluted rewards they split. An honest agent pays 12 deals once and keeps undiluted rewards.
